nodes.text: Perform physical exam; Perform imaging for staging; Perform and/or collect PSA and calculate PSADT; Estimate life expectancy (Principles of Life Expectancy Estimation [PROS-A]); Perform germline and somatic genetic testing (if not previously done); Obtain family history; Assess quality-of-life measures

ADT with docetaxel and one of the following: Preferred: Abiraterone (category 1), Darolutamide (category 1); Other Recommended: Apalutamide (category 2B), Enzalutamide (category 2B); or ADT with one of the following: Preferred: Abiraterone (category 1), Apalutamide (category 1), Enzalutamide (category 1); Other Recommended: Darolutamide; or ADT with: Useful in Certain Circumstances: Niraparib/abiraterone (BRCA2m only); or ADT with: Capivasertib/abiraterone (in very select patients with PTEN deficiency only; category 2B)
Physical examination + PSA every 3–6 mo; Imaging for symptoms; Periodic imaging to monitor treatment response
Workup and Treatment of M1 CRPC (PROS-17)
